test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What price should a shopkeeper mark on an article, costing him ₹210, to gain 16% after allowing a discount of 16%?
solution:
Given:

Cost price = ₹210

Gain = 16%

Discount = 16%

Concept used:

Marked Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Rise%

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Gain%

Calculation:

Selling price of the article = 210 + 210 × 16%

⇒ ₹243.6

Let the marked price of the article be M.

According to the question,

M - M × 16% = 243.6

⇒ 0.84M = 243.6

⇒ M = 243.6/0.84

⇒ M = 290

∴ The shopkeeper should mark the article **at ****₹290.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

CP/MP = (100 - D%)/(100 + P%)

⇒ 210/MP = (100 - 16)/(100 + 16)

⇒ 210/MP = 84/116

⇒ MP = 210 × 116/84

⇒ MP = 290

**Hence, the correct answer is Rs. 290.**
